method: Assistant manual review of the full top-1 prompt text for 22 semantic queries. Not a human-labeled benchmark, visual review, or top-3 precision score. Exact-title and nonsense probes are excluded.

rubric.relevant: Main subject and requested format/style match
rubric.partial: Related subject or genre, but a requested constraint is missing or contradicted
rubric.off_topic: Main subject or scenario does not match
